questions.stem: Identify the disorder in which destruction of smooth muscle and elastic tissue by chronic necrotizing infections leads to permanent dilation of bronchi and bronchioles:
questions.solutionHtml:
Bronchiectasis
  • Bronchiectasis is a condition in which there is permanent dilation of bronchi and bronchioles due to the destruction of smooth muscle and elastic tissue by chronic necrotizing infections.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 683

questions.stem: All of the following statements are true regarding primary ciliary dyskinesia except:

options.label: B
options.text: Occurs due to mutation involving dynein protein

options.label: C
options.text: It is also associated with Kartagener syndrome

questions.solutionHtml:
It is X-linked syndrome
  • Primary ciliary dyskinesia (PCD) is not an X-linked syndrome, but rather an autosomal recessive disorder.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 683

questions.stem: A 45-year-old male presents to the clinic with a chronic cough and recurrent respiratory infections. On examination, there are crackles heard on auscultation. A CT scan shows permanent dilation of bronchi and bronchioles. All of the following features are true regarding the diagnosis except:

options.label: D
options.text: Squamous Metaplasia is not a feature

questions.answerText: Squamous Metaplasia is not a feature
questions.solutionHtml:
Squamous Metaplasia is not a feature
  • The given clinical feature is suggestive of Bronchiectasis.
  • Squamous metaplasia, which is the transformation of the normal respiratory epithelium into squamous epithelium, is a feature of bronchiectasis.
  • It is a response to chronic inflammation and irritation and can further contribute to the damage and dilation of the bronchi.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 684
